text_block_list.text:
You don't need to worry about it. I'm sure 
I would've messed up too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Besides, that serious expression clearly 
conveyed how earnest the Trainer was.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Even without a plushie, that alone is more 
than enough for me.
It ended in a disappointing result...
